title: How Anthropic employees use Claude Tag
summary: Claude Tag (Claude integrated into Slack) streamlines internal workflows, shifting time from information synthesis to higher-judgment work. Marketing, product ops, and legal teams report 10-100x time savings: document preparation in 45 minutes, week-long data consolidations in hours, and compliance reviews cut from a day to 30 minutes.

title: How Warp builds self-improving agents on Claude
summary: Warp demonstrates self-improving agents using Claude's Skills framework, where paired "base" and "improver" skills institutionalize feedback loops with human oversight through code review. Deployed at scale for spec-writing, review, and triage across Warp's repo, the pattern breaks through agent accuracy plateaus while keeping humans in control.

title: Claude in Chrome is generally available
summary: Claude in Chrome moves from pilot to general availability across all paid plans, enabling autonomous web browsing including page reading, form filling, and site navigation. Three-layer prompt-injection defense achieved 0% attack success rate in red-team testing, extending Claude's utility to internal dashboards, legacy systems, and vendor portals without direct integrations.

title: Building commerce agents with Claude
summary: Anthropic launches a commerce agents blueprint enabling retailers, travel companies, and marketplaces to build AI shopping assistants deployable across Claude API, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Foundry, and Google Cloud. Early enterprise users report 35% larger shopping carts and 60% higher purchase completion rates, with partners including Shopify, Priceline, Visa, and Mastercard deploying working agents in under an hour.

title: A guide to the anatomy of effective commerce agents
summary: A comprehensive guide covers architecture, optimization, and production deployment of commerce agents with reusable patterns for retail, travel, telecom, and ticketing. Key techniques include UI components as tools, skills-based architecture to preserve context, and aggressive prompt caching achieving 90-99% hit rates, emphasizing safety enforcement through technical harness rather than prompts alone.

title: How an Anthropic field marketer uses Claude Code to send weekly personalized updates to every sales rep
summary: An Anthropic field marketer automated personalized weekly sales briefings for each rep using Claude Code, pulling data from BigQuery, HubSpot, Clay, and Salesforce to generate customized Monday digests. The workflow expanded from a pilot sales team to BDRs and customer success, demonstrating how non-technical staff can build scalable AI solutions that doubled executive dinner registrations.
